hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

Attached to the Implementation Profile https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/raster-reprojection (implementsProfile), after checking its signature (docs/ATTACHMENTS.md).

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/raster-reprojection, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature, http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature.

prefLabel: Reproject a raster onto a regular grid
definition: Reprojects a raster onto a regular grid covering a bounding box.

assumedFormatGaps.name: band_file
assumedFormatGaps.reason: The CWL (GeoLabs/KindGrove v0.0.2-rc2, `reproject_band`) declares no `format` on this File, so the processDescription derived by eoap.cct.cwl-to-ogcprocess serves application/octet-stream: the deployment exposes no media type for the GeoTIFF it reads and writes. Closed upstream if the CWL declares `format: ogc:geotiff`.
assumedFormatGaps.evidence: Run record `kindgrove-steps` (scripts/sources.yaml): the three band_file inputs (red.tif, green.tif, nir.tif) and the three reprojected_file outputs (red_4326.tif, green_4326.tif, nir_4326.tif), the files of runs/kindgrove-steps/ro/data/ that primary.cwlprov.provn links to them by specializationOf (lines 157-268), are TIFF files (magic number 49 49 2a 00) carrying the GeoTIFF tags GeoKeyDirectory (34735), ModelTiepoint (33922) and ModelPixelScale (33550), observed 2026-11-10.
